verdict.rationale: Meta ships its own guardrail models: Llama Guard 3, an 8B safeguard model that classifies both LLM inputs and responses against the MLCommons hazards taxonomy, and Prompt Guard, documented as a filter to run before each LLM call. These directly cover the story's 'gating' pattern, but only as models a developer must deploy and wire in, not as a hosted moderation endpoint or configurable safety settings, and the docs portal is behind a login. missing for 10: a hosted moderation endpoint or configurable safety settings, an end-to-end documented pattern for gating model output before it triggers actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the safeguard models' effectiveness.

support.subject: As a developer, the platform gives me guardrail primitives — moderation endpoints, safety settings, or documented patterns for gating model output before it acts

citations.quote: a 8B Llama 3 safeguard model for classifying LLM inputs and responses.
It is suitable to run as a filter prior to each call to an LLM in an application.
Llama Guard 3: a Llama-3.1-8B pretrained model, aligned to safeguard against the MLCommons standardized hazards taxonomy
